arguments.query:
WITH fee AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` WHERE ID = 64
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.merchant, m.account_type
FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` m ON p.merchant = m.merchant
CROSS JOIN fee f
WHERE p.year = 2023
  AND p.card_scheme = f.card_scheme
  AND p.is_credit = f.is_credit
  AND 'D' IN UNNEST(f.aci)
  AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR (p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country) = (f.intracountry = 1))
  AND (m.account_type IS NULL OR m.account_type != 'S')
ORDER BY p.merchant
